text: Homebrewing beer requires strict adherence to safety and hygiene protocols to ensure both the quality of the product and the safety of the brewer. First and foremost, cleanliness is critical to prevent contamination. All equipment must be thoroughly sanitized before use, and brewers should follow recipe instructions precisely to maintain consistency and safety. Additionally, because the brewing process involves flammable materials and open heat sources, it is essential to keep a fire extinguisher readily accessible in the brewing area.
